dedupe_keys.name: rete ciclabile piano regionale della mobilita ciclistica prmc

description: Rete Ciclabile Piano Regionale della Mobilità Ciclistica (PRMC) is a dataset listed in Italian Catalogue of metadata for Spatial Data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by geoportale.regione.lombardia.it. The information layer represents the Cycle Network of Regional Interest, as identified in the Regional Cycling Mobility Plan (PRMC), provided for by Law No 7/2009 and approved by DGR X/1657 of 11/04/2014. Attention THE NETWORK IS THIS PIANIFICATE, in various cases does not correspond to existing routes or walkable in conditions of adequate safety. Coverage: IT. The portal shows the English title as "Cycling Network Regional Cycling Mobility Plan (PRMC)" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include rete ciclabile, prmc, pcir, mobilità ciclistica, mobilità sostenibile, mobilità lenta. The listing shows 2014-11-19 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-rndt.
